name: 21201 · Baltimore, MD
findings: ZIP 21201 (Baltimore) has 392 nonprofit organizations. 175 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 155 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21201 (Baltimore) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21201 (Baltimore) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 155 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
